components.explanation: The 11-state Fighter (fighter.gd): the attack table in seconds (lines 41-45), step() on the 60 Hz physics tick, hitboxes, hitstop, wind, and the five signals out. The system the pitch proposes to package as Fighter.tscn.

What drives a fighter today: main.gd creates both fighters in code, sets opponent and spawn_cork, and calls step() in _simulate (lines 180-182); input actions from controls.gd (J jab, K cutlass, S rewind); Rivet's deterministic rules in rivet_brain.gd. The coupling the pitch names as its risk.
The A7 clips, jab_action and wind_key_cycle, put at state_t every tick by the fighter; one authority per animated node.
The suites that pin the system at a7 and that the pitch's first milestone must keep: pins (49), structure (57), edges (70), re-run for this film.
